newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco prods rise as higher diffs offset NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco prods rise as higher diffs offset NYMEX.

text.p: Most U.S. Midcontinent spot product prices erased early losses Friday afternoon, amid pressure to close deals before next week's Christmas holiday.
Prices tracked firmer differentials, which offset a fall in NYMEX products as an increasing supply of distillates were shipped up the huge Colonial Pipeline Friday.
NYMEX January gasoline settled 1.03 cents lower at 70.19 cents a gallon, and front-month heating oil dropped 0.81 cent to 72.97 cents a gallon.
Diffs for jet fuel in Group Three tightened, with bids up one cent in the afternoon to stand 4.00 cents under the NYMEX.
